title: docs(adr-0066): record that D4's three landing steps and the sys_* MCP follow-up have landed
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DRAvoKK4WGPwFkh7crrTU5R)_

Fixes #27694
Fixes #27956

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0066 D4 的 2026-10-29 修订下面加一条带日期的注记（2026-10-30），记录三件已落地的事：`sys_*` 对象上的动作经 MCP 的缺口已由 #27940 关闭（按动作逐条看 `ai.exposed: true`，存储元数据表照旧在读开关前就拒绝，后面各闸不变）；第 2 步 #27649 已落地；第 3 步 #27611（PR #27793）已落地。原句不改，标为「按当日读，被本注记取代」。Status 行补一句落地记录。`requiredPermissions` 文档注释里的「Landing, as of 2026-10-29」整段删掉。
- 为什么改：ADR 还写着「sys_* 动作留在 MCP 之外、#27681 承接」和「控制台仍直接请求 `target`」，两句在 main 上都已不成立；随 `@objectstack/spec` 的 `.d.ts` 发出的注释还在说控制台条款和「#27694 会删掉本段」。治理文本说错，等于给作者和 agent 讲错规则。
- 风险与回滚：两个文件 +3/−6，只动 ADR 正文和一段 JSDoc 注释；不改 `.describe()`、不改代码、无生成物变化、不发布（`skip-changeset`）。回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` D4 修订段下面新加的 `> **Note (2026-10-30, #27956, #27694)**` 那一段，再看第 3 行 Status 末尾新加的「Landed: …」一句。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`，预期 exit 0，符号锚 623 个（597 个声明锚），main 上是 614（588）；多出的 9 个就是注记里引用的 9 个符号，以后改名或挪走会转红。
- 需要你做的：暂无。contract review owed（契约复审未完成，席位复审后再求批）；落地档以登记表在 PR 上的读数为准，预期 Tier H，需受管批准人（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）批准。

## What changes

Two files, +3 / −6, one commit on `origin/main` `6b125a7a`.

- **`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`, D4.** A dated note, `Note (2026-10-30, #27956, #27694)`, goes under the 2026-10-29 amendment paragraph, in the ADR's own note style (Prime Directive #13: the recorded sentence stays and a note goes under it). It says the amendment reads as of its date, and that two of its clauses are superseded by the note, not deleted: the closing "Until step 2 lands …" sentence, and "stay off MCP … card #27681 carries it". Then it records:
  - (a) the `sys_*` MCP gap is closed by PR #27940 (#27681, ruling `6513869839`, letter B). The rule is per action: a `sys_*` action is listed and run over MCP only when it declares `ai.exposed: true` itself. One predicate (`systemObjectActionExposureError`) answers for `run_action`, the `list_actions` filter and the `resume_run` admission, and the tool layer's filter yields only to the bridge's attestation (`isListableAction`). The stored-metadata family is refused before the flag is read (`isStoredMetadataBodyObject`). Every gate after admission is unchanged;
  - (b) step 2 landed (PR #27649, 2026-10-29);
  - (c) step 3 landed (PR #27793 for #27611, 2026-10-30). The off-origin and undeclared/object-less clicks still fetch `target` directly.
- **ADR-0066, Status line.** After the recorded "The server half lands under #27506; see the note under D4.", one sentence records the landings: server half PR #27649 (2026-10-29), step 3 PR #27793 for #27611 (2026-10-30), the `sys_*` follow-up PR #27940 for #27681 (2026-10-30, ruling `6513869839`). This is should-fix 1 of the first-pass review 6515866455.
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, the `requiredPermissions` docblock.** The "Landing, as of 2026-10-29" paragraph is removed. Once the console clause and the self-removal sentence go, what is left ("ADR-0066 records the decision; the server half … is on `main`") is a landing status with nothing pending. The paragraph above it already cites ADR-0066 D4 as amended 2026-10-29. No `.describe()` change.

## Why

The amendment's present-tense clauses are false on `main`:

- `invokeBusinessAction`, the `list_actions` bridge (`buildMcpBridge`) and `resumeAdmissionRefusal` all call `systemObjectActionExposureError` (bc496bf7d). It returns `null` for a `sys_*` action that declares `ai.exposed: true`. It refuses `sys_metadata` / `sys_metadata_history` before reading the flag. `isSystemObjectName` is still its first test, so the amendment's citation of it still resolves and stays true as the "which objects" test.
- `useConsoleActionRuntime` and `RecordDetailView` send a declared same-origin api click to `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` through `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/apiActionDoor.ts` (b00e3f496). An off-origin target, an inline button that names no declared action, and an object-less action keep the direct fetch, as that module's header says.

## Verification

- `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: exit 0. Head: 623 symbol anchors (597 declaration, 26 literal), 2163 file-level. Base `6b125a7a`: 614 (588, 26), 2163. The +9 declaration anchors are the nine new citations; every one resolves.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 74 families derived after the commit. All 74 exit 0. `--ran` reconcile: 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. That is after a whole-tree `turbo run build` (116/116), because 15 families exit 3 or miss generated inputs in a fresh worktree.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run test`: 756 files, 22510 passed, 1 todo.
- Generated outputs: `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface` and `check:api-surface` exit 0, and the tree is clean after the build. `git grep "Landing, as of 2026-10-29"` on base hits only the source file, so no generated file carries this JSDoc.
- Changeset: none. JSDoc and ADR prose only; the label is `skip-changeset`, as on the first pass (#27965).

Out of scope, as #27956 says: the action-invocation audit row (#27908) and the platform `ai` declarations (#27900).
